# FlarePix

> FlarePix is a product visual studio for Amazon and ecommerce sellers. Photo, video, AI imagery, and AI video from one studio, one workflow. Based in Qingdao, China; serving sellers worldwide (US + Europe, English).

Positioning: a professional video production studio that uses AI tools — not a self-serve AI tool. AI imagery is lead-gen (self-teachable); AI video is the real moat (needs a professional team for quality control). Real case work includes body composition scales, kids toys, and tissue products.

## Services

- [Product Photography & Video Services](https://www.flarepix.com/services): overview of all service categories (photo + video, by product type)
- [AI Imagery](https://www.flarepix.com/services/ai-imagery): AI-generated lifestyle/on-model/campaign visuals from a single product photo
- [AI Video](https://www.flarepix.com/services/ai-video): AI-generated short product video, managed end-to-end with human quality review
- [Brand Film Production](https://www.flarepix.com/services/brand-film): cinematic real-footage brand films for flagship launches

## Work & case studies

- [Our Work](https://www.flarepix.com/work): portfolio across photo, video, and AI
